cardOverview.overviewText: A Parakram Select variant providing enhanced lifestyle perks, milestone benefits, and travel privileges, dedicated to defense community members.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.howToAvail: Visit www.teetimes.golftripz.com and create a Golftripz account using the same email ID as registered with ICICI Bank Credit Cards.|The complimentary round of golf will be visible in your Golftripz account after the 10th day of the next month. This will be available for you to play anytime in the next 2 months.
benefitRows.exclusion: Rounds can be availed only if monthly spends are more than ₹50k.

benefitRows.name: Insurance

benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact ICICI Bank helpline or ICICI Lombard General toll-free number at 1800-2666.
